name: idempiere-mcp
description: Skills for interacting with iDempiere ERP via Model Context Protocol (MCP), including tenant/system authentication, table creation and column management, table index creation and validation, Java model generation, window tab field configuration, centralized ID setup, and 2Pack package import (pack in).
suggestedPrompts: Create a new table in iDempiere
Add a new column to an iDempiere table
Add an index to an iDempiere table
Generate Java model class for an iDempiere table
Add a new field to an iDempiere window tab
